new_value: Implemented Rust channel-selection parity in rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs: announce-driven CCP-9 priority with channel-plan bounds, density >10 CH0 fallback, u32 epoch encoding, and retained optional deployment-wide GNSS/CCP-12 mode. Added unit coverage for announce precedence, dense fallback, out-of-plan announcements, and updated all callers/tests. Validation: cargo test -p lichen-core passed 424 unit tests, all integration tests, and 15 doc tests; rustfmt --check and git diff --check passed. Three delegated Kimi-K3 review attempts were made but all failed before review due to insufficient OpenRouter credits; local correctness/security/edge review found no defects.
